entry.title: Lipoprotein(a) as a Biomarker in the Acute Myocardial Infarction Setting
entry.summary: Lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is an established genetically determined causal risk enhancer for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. entry.title: Dyslipidemia as a Risk Factor for Pregnancy Loss: A Systematic Review
